_decision: The second half of F-2: 'railButton = 38px / railIcon = 20px'. This spec covers the 20px icon; F-2.json covers the 38px button.
_why_a_separate_spec: An independent review of F-2 found that its check asserted only the button box, leaving the icon half of its own decision record unguarded — correct at the time (measured 20x20), with nothing to catch a regression. A single spec addresses exactly one anchor, but `anchor` and `divergence` are SEPARATE fields in run-checks.mjs: the anchor is matched in the DOM, only `divergence` is looked up in the database. So this spec measures a different element while writing its evidence to the same divergence row. Worth knowing generally — it means a divergence asserting several things about several elements is fully checkable, contrary to what the one-anchor-per-spec shape first suggests.
_scope: Anchored to the icon inside the FIRST pinned rail button, the same representative instance F-2 uses. Proves that icon, not all 27.
